c: Phas3r is a weapon from the base game version of Vampire Survivors that was introduced in Patch 1.9.0. It is the starting weapon of
. It is unlocked by getting it to level 7.

c: Phas3r emits horizontal colorful beams of light centered around an enemy, starting with red, then yellow, blue, magenta, with orange replacing red when it is not the first shot of the sequence. The red beams can target enemies from further away and fire in a big burst, the max

of the burst is increased at certain levels; the remaining beams split up the leftover Amount for the sequence, usually only firing up to 1 or 2 at once as each level also increases how many shots is fired for each sequence in the same amount of time. Each time the weapon shoots, it plays a note. As the weapon levels up, the fire rate increases and makes the melody it plays more apparent.
only affects the beams horizontally. Amount is multiplied by 4 for this weapon.
Phas3r has 8 levels. At max level, Phas3r has +10 Base Damage, +150%
Generates thin damaging zones. High Amount scaling.
Base Area up by 50%. Base Damage up by 3.
Base Area up by 50%. Base Damage up by 3.
Base Area up by 50%. Base Damage up by 4.

Note: While not directly implemented into the level up stats, it is apparent that the Interval is shortened each level. It is likely a measure to ensure the melody it plays is under the control of the weapon's programming rather than through normal stat changes from the level up system.
With Limit Break, Phas3r can be further leveled up.
See Combos for a list of all item interactions.
